title: DESPERADO · EP01 사십 초 뒤
basis: v14.1 revised after three-work benchmark;88 drawing panels

cuts.action: Concert arena at night, young clean-shaven chestnut-haired male idol, black sparkling blazer, LEFT hand microphone, RIGHT hand black glove with one pink diamond. Big stage and audience.

Two hours earlier ordinary workshop. All FIVE crew around a modest table with three photographic reference prints, not a game world map. Lax older gray beard olive jacket points at a loading entrance photograph.
Chanho grins with BARE dirty fingertips beside replica glove in case, Wontouch looks at his dirty fingers. Ddakji natural adult slim proportions. Chanho does NOT wear any glove.

During normal dock work a worker steps down from the raised loading apron front into outside van lane, drop only0.9m and full human height visible. Pedestrian checkpoint sits separately off right; clear open dock front and exterior road are established BEFORE escape.
Security worker compares Chanho and Wontouch badges to manifest, hand indicates boundary. Ddakji and Bbeokkugi wait beyond behind them, identities checked too.

cuts.action: Actual normal work demonstration below stage: worker loads scenic crate onto circular turntable at WEST stop, distinct stationary surrounding walkway.
Same circular scenic turntable rotating180degrees with crate, solid surface and outer rail. West and east opposed docks remain fixed. No people jumping between rotating edges.
Turntable stopped at EAST docking point. Worker folds down a short manual bridging ramp over shallow forty-centimetre gap to unload crate toward freight lift. Bbeokkugi observes as ordinary worker.
Dressing room, stylist adds a small metallic repair clip to inside cuff of idol RIGHT glove, visibly one pink gemstone. Young idol holds left-hand mic separately.
Close cuff with clip folded inside and out of sight; glove exterior unchanged. The crew not present and not watching.

Ddakji in permitted work corridor catches a falling marker pen and returns it to responsible jewel custodian, ponytail charcoal suit. Natural little smile, no exaggerated glamour. Key hangs at custodian belt.
Chanho and Wontouch set down real work crate inside allowed boundary; in depth service corridor door is still closed, restricted access beyond. They wait instead of walking freely.
Small wall safety mirror at corridor corner reflects approaching security guard before actual guard rounds corner. Ddakji sees reflection.

Ddakji pulls Chanho sleeve BEHIND an opaque perpendicular wall corner; Wontouch hidden behind same opaque wall. Guard walks on OTHER side of corner and cannot see trio. No exposed standing in line of sight.
Guard now walks away far beyond corner. ONLY Ddakji Chanho Wontouch in foreground recess, NO Bbeokkugi or Lax. Ddakji motions them to proceed after clear.

Authorized custodian uses her photoID at vault door reader, green authorization, carrying protected original glove. Empty glass case inside; no preinstalled bodyharness. Marker left on outside ledger shelf.
Custodian closes original glove case, weight green, then removes3-key brassring. Normal card authorization disarms floor temporarily; stolen casekey does not grant floor authorization.

Custodian exits after normal storage. Ddakji hands back same marker, custodian reaches. Framing hides specific theft method while next image reveals key now in Ddakji palm. No practical pickpocket tutorial.
Ddakji palm contains key; custodian has moved away down corridor. Chanho takes key from Ddakji. They are no longer standing beside staff while speaking.

Closed secure costume room layout viewed from door: safe dry service threshold LEFT, beyond it continuous dark pressure mat to case pedestal RIGHT, steel rail fixed to solid ceiling, one back-wall camera. No hole in ceiling.

ONLY Ddakji checks Chanho CHEST and PELVIS harness at safe threshold, Wontouch huge BLACK CREWCUT clean-shaven black jacket burgundy collar controls chain. NO graybeard olive Lax NO glasses boy. Protective pouch fixed to body.

Secure room wide side view, Wontouch boots on safe threshold left holds trolley travel line and brake. Chanho supported by TWO straps at CHEST and PELVIS, suspended prone above pressure mat toward locked case at right. Ddakji outside same door watching corridor.
Close Wontouch hand brake and traction line connected visibly to firmly ceiling-mounted rail trolley. No arm-only lifting. Boots on threshold, sensor mat starts beyond feet.
Chanho reaches physical key into side lock of CLOSED glass case, left hand steady on rim; chest and hip support lines visible, feet never touch mat.

Open case. Chanho looks at inside cuff of the ONE original glove lifted from hand form, small metal repair clip visible. Replica stays INSIDE his separate pouch with only black cuff edge visible, total TWO gloves maximum. No third upright glove behind.
Compare original cuff with metal repair clip and replica cuff missing clip, clearly two separate right gloves. Chanho gaze identifies discrepancy.
Chanho hand stops before closing lid; Wontouch continues holding brake and watches, Ddakji at door. Clock remaining12sec separate small insert.
Two hands transfer tiny repair clip from original cuff to replica matching cuff. Open case and pale fitted cradle underneath.
Original right glove with pink gemstone closes inside fitted protective small hard pouch strapped to Chanho chest. No three hands, no glove lying naked.
Replica now includes repair clip in cuff. Chanho settles replica onto same cradle and closes case with key.
Identical weight-check light as normal scene turns green, Chanho exhales quietly. Both real and fake locations unambiguous.

Replay timer approaches zero, Wontouch draws trolley toward LEFT safe threshold. Case closed far RIGHT contains UPRIGHT REPLICA glove on pale hand form, pink gemstone visible. Original already in body pouch. No empty case.
Concert crowd cheers, idol stops leaving stage, looks at stage director with one finger raised requesting extra song. LEFT mic, RIGHT glove now absent.
Stage director tells custodian glove needed for unplanned encore. Bbeokkugi at distant permitted work station hears actual request, steps away before radioing.

Control room screen camera replay ends and live image shows suspended intruder. Other corridor footage also recorded; officer compares rather than ignoring.
Vault side view, Wontouch draws trolley back left, Chanho still secured at chest/hips, guards approach visible far down corridor behind Ddakji; case closed far right.
Close Wontouch grips Chanho shoulder strap only to steady while overhead trolley brings body above safe threshold, releasing brake controlled.
Chanho boots land on safe threshold LEFT of pressure mat, Wontouch steadies shoulder, Ddakji holds door. Original hard pouch still strapped; both hands free.
Three crew exit door and Ddakji closes it, delaying pursuing guards only briefly. No electronic lock magically disabled.

West stair already blocked by competent guards. Three crew stop hidden behind opaque corner wall. Bbeokkugi radios Lax from separate exterior work station to route van east now. No crew visible to guards yet.

Turntable is STOPPED at west. Ddakji steps onto deck behind scenic crate, Chanho follows, Wontouch last. Fixed landing and rotating edge visible with no gap jumping.
Overhead large spatial panel: all THREE crouched behind crate on solid circular deck at WEST, EAST landing opposite connects freight lift. Distinct fixed walkway skirts outside whole circle.
Deck starts rotating carrying same crate and three hidden crew, west doorway slides away behind them. Chanho keeps protective pouch secure.
Pursuing guard reaches empty west dock as deck moves away, sees east direction and radios team rather than jumping stupidly.

Deck STOPPED at EAST. Wontouch unfolds short ramp first across service gap, then Ddakji steps across with Chanho. Gap40cm WIDE and1.2m DEEP, BOTTOM VISIBLE, not a bottomless pit. All on same geographic east side as earlier.
Ddakji and Chanho on fixed east landing, Wontouch holds manual bridging ramp steady then crosses last. This gap was introduced in normal work and has a1.2m bottom visible,40cm width.

rules: Reference cast v9 natural adult proportions.
No floating dialogue gutters; balloons belong inside their panels and point at visible speaker.
Only one column in final reader, no ambiguous left/right reading order.
Chest+pelvis support, true ceiling-mounted rail; Wontouch controls brake and trolley.
Original secured before active movement; passing pouch before final low dock jump is explicit.
Key stolen after original lock; clip corrected before green check; key missing on unplanned reissue triggers alarm.
West and east turntable fixed docks; board only stopped, disembark only stopped; guard routes east.
East0.9m open loading edge and street lane shown before jump.
No M04 invention, no injured-superpowered Chanho hands.
